name: 测量摘要实验 / Measurement summary
description: 从自带的虚构 CSV 数据生成 JSON 和 Markdown 摘要，修改阈值可比较结果。 / Summarize a small invented CSV dataset and compare thresholds.
changelog:
## 中文
1.1：阈值由12秒改为10秒，四条相同测量中超过阈值的数量由2变为3；原输入数据和运行代码保留。
## English
1.1: Lower the threshold from 12 to 10 seconds. Three rather than two of the same four measurements exceed it; source data and execution code stay the same.
